author: Crazy_
body:
Hi there. My mincraft ign is Crazy_Creeper521. I appear to be banned for ban evasion on the account called 'Erynor'. I have never heard of this account, nor used any hacked clients on the server (as the account appears to be banned for Kill Aura and FastPlace).

I have never hacked on Avicus. I never plan on doing so. To be honest, I don't plan on hacking on any networks. Obviously IP's matched to make it look like I was ban evading on this account. Which I was/am not. As I stated before, I've never heard of the account 'Erynor'. I do have a brother so it could have possibly been him. I'm not sure.

Thanks for your time reading this. I'm sure you get plenty of appeals.
